requested_by: owner 2026-10-20: 'it can't be global values... it must be per league'
finding_that_triggered_it: v9 O/U probabilities sit near one global level in every league (NF backtest: Argentina real Over 36.1% vs v9 51.2%; Norway/China real 59.7% vs v9 53.0%; Bundesliga 2 real 58.0% vs v9 50.0%)
arm: PER_LEAGUE_CAL: logit p' = a_L + b_L * logit p_v9, fitted by log loss on all EARLIER blocks of league L only; (a_L, b_L) shrunk toward the global (a_G, b_G) fitted on all earlier blocks of the track: weight n_L/(n_L+K), K=300 matches; a league with no earlier rows uses the global fit; first block of a track uses identity
also_reported: GLOBAL_CAL (same, no league terms) to separate 'v9 is squeezed' from 'v9 lacks the league level'
data: experiments/ou_info_inputs_2026_10/eval_rows.parquet p_base (v9 own train(), quarterly walk-forward); market for the standard track = football-data PRE-MATCH Avg; new_format market comparison not used (prices invalid, see market_anchor)
primary_metric: log loss, PER_LEAGUE_CAL minus V9, per track
decision_rule: v9 PROPOSAL candidate for a track only if dLL <= -0.001 AND 90% day-block CI upper < 0 AND it does not lose to GLOBAL_CAL. Bets reported descriptively at the live floors (3%/8%) at the pre-match price (standard only). Owner decides; nothing changes in v9 from this study.
frozen: K, the arm and the rule are not changed after results are seen
